name: com.autech.levelplay-mediation
description: Unity LevelPlay (Unity Ads) mediation wrapper with a choice of GDPR consent paths: InMobi CMP (IAB TCF v2.2) or a built-in local consent form. Adds CCPA/COPPA flags, iOS ATT handling, Meta Audience Network advertiser-tracking setup, and encrypted Remove-Ads persistence. Mirrors the Autech AdMob Mediation package API so game code migrates with namespace changes only.

samples.description: Complete example scene with AdsExampleUI and all ad-format demos, wired to the LevelPlayBootstrap prefab.
Ready-to-use LevelPlayBootstrap prefab; copied once to Assets/Autech/LevelPlay/Prefabs.
InMobi CMP (Choice) plugin v2.0.1 — the IAB TCF v2.2 GDPR consent dependency. The package detects it on load and offers to import it automatically; you can also import it here manually.
